messages:
sam_peopleops: Hey team — heads up: open enrollment portal showed "500 error" for a few hours this morning. I had a coworker who couldn't submit before the 11:59pm deadline. Can we get a formal short extension for those affected?

lina_benefits: Ugh, sorry about that. We saw intermittent outages at ~09:10-10:30 PST due to a vendor auth token rotation. We're evaluating impact. Do we have a count of affected users?

sam_peopleops: I have 3 folks who reported failure + one message to benefits@ saying their upload failed. Could be more.

zoe_payroll: FYI payroll cutoff for deductions is midnight PST tonight; we can still pick up late adds if HR extends the enrollment window and we get a list before payroll batch starts at 02:00. After that it's manual adjustments.

alex_engineer: Confirming — I hit the 500 around 09:18 and again at 09:45. I retried and submitted at 10:40 and it accepted. Willing to help test if you reopen.

lina_benefits: Thanks Alex and Sam. We can offer a 24-hour extension for people who attempted submission during the outage window. We'll need evidence (screenshot of error, or email to benefits@) and a short attestation. Can payroll accept an exceptions list?

zoe_payroll: Yes — if benefits provides a signed exceptions CSV with: employee_id, name, requested_elections, original_attempt_timestamp, and supporting artifact link, we can route to an expedited payroll job and apply deductions retroactively as of the original effective date.

sam_peopleops: Cool. What wording should I send to the company? I can put a short announcement in #general.

lina_benefits: Draft: "Open enrollment: deadline extended 24 hours for employees impacted by today's portal outage (09:10-10:30 PST). If you attempted to submit during that window and received an error, please upload a screenshot to benefits@redwood.com and complete enrollment by 11:59pm PST tomorrow. Payroll will process retro deductions for validated exceptions." Thoughts?

alex_engineer: Add: "Include the time of your attempt and any error message." Otherwise good.

hrbot: Incident note: vendor auth token rotation caused transient 500 errors affecting benefits portal (09:10-10:30 PST). Ops ticket #INC-2026-182 created.

lina_benefits: That wording works. Sam — pls post and cc benefits@. Also attach the simple attestation form link: https://benefits.redwood.com/attestation. We'll collect screenshots and compile the exceptions CSV.

sam_peopleops: Posted in #general and pinned the attestation link. I'll collect reports and send the CSV to payroll by 01:15am PST tomorrow.

zoe_payroll: Great — once we get the CSV we'll schedule the expedited job. Any folks who submit after payroll cutoff without supporting artifact will need manual reconciliation next pay cycle.

sam_peopleops: Thanks all. Also leaving a note for infra to prevent token rotations during business hours :)

hrbot: Reminder: If you emailed benefits@, include your employee ID in the subject line to speed processing.
